reviews.text: Not a pleasant experience with a receptionist.

Even though my dog is poorly and has not being able to eat. Wasn't interested as soon as I said I was on benefits,. So really only bothered about the money they receive! and not the animal at all!.. 😕👎 …

Normally ok but my last visit to rubery this week i wasn't happy.. i arrived for my appointment and the receptionist asked me to wait outside because theirs another bulldog inside which was aggressive.. WITH NO MUZZLE ON.  i am disabled and i was cold waiting outside standing up for 10 minutes.. i was not happy being treated like this.. APPALLING really.. won't be going back here..
Our rusty passed away at home and they were so brilliant and supportive they kept him till they picked him up to cremate him no cost and were lovely
These vets are amazing polite staff amazing vets and always smells clean and fresh 😍 …
